categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily operates in two main business segments: aerospace components and tooling, and precision components for multiple civilian industries. It focuses on the research, manufacturing, and sales of aerospace parts including aircraft structural components, engine parts, and onboard equipment. Additionally, it has expanded into sectors such as shipbuilding, electronics, semiconductors, and big data analysis, maintaining a dual focus on military and civilian products.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company has developed 12 core proprietary technologies related to aerospace manufacturing, including deformation control for thin-walled metal structures, high-efficiency multi-axis machining of high-temperature alloys, composite processing of ultra-high-strength steel components, and intelligent CNC programming with online detection. It employs advanced manufacturing methods such as multi-axis machining, composite machining, flexible zero-point clamping systems, and specialized welding techniques for high-performance aerospace components. The company also integrates digital management systems like MES and pursues intelligent manufacturing and automation.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include major state-owned military-industrial groups such as Aviation Industry Corporation of China, China Aviation Engine Group, China Aerospace Science and Technology Corporation, China Shipbuilding Group, and China Electronics Technology Group. The company serves primarily military aerospace manufacturers and main aircraft manufacturers, with growing business in civilian sectors including telecommunications, electronics, and semiconductors. Its products are used in aircraft airframes, engines, landing gear, avionics, and other aerospace systems.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly within China, with headquarters and major facilities located in Suzhou and subsidiaries in Zhengzhou. Its customer base is predominantly domestic, serving Chinese military and civilian aerospace manufacturers and related industries. There is minimal international sales exposure reported.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates primarily as a midstream manufacturer and processor in the aerospace supply chain, focusing on precision machining and assembly of aerospace components and tooling. It acts as a key supplier to aircraft OEMs and engine manufacturers, providing complex structural parts and assemblies. It also extends its manufacturing capabilities to civilian precision components, positioning itself as a comprehensive component supplier rather than a raw material provider or end-product assembler.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include deepening aerospace core technology innovation, expanding into new civilian markets, and developing intelligent manufacturing capabilities. The company emphasizes R&D in advanced machining processes, materials science, and digital manufacturing technologies. It invests in AI-related computing power services and collaborates with academic institutions for talent and technology development. Future plans focus on market expansion, technology-driven product diversification, internal management optimization, and talent development with a strong emphasis on sustainable growth and innovation.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated mainly through direct sales of aerospace components and tooling products, as well as precision components for civilian industries. The company also derives income from providing computing power services and sales related to AI infrastructure. Sales are primarily conducted via direct sales channels, with pricing based on product complexity, labor hours, material costs, and negotiated contracts with customers.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is positioned as a leading private aerospace component manufacturer in China with comprehensive capabilities across airframe, engine, and onboard equipment parts. It competes with other military and civilian aerospace suppliers, including state-owned enterprises and emerging private firms. Its competitive advantages lie in proprietary technologies, quality certifications, and strong relationships with major military-industrial customers. The company has received multiple awards recognizing its quality and supplier excellence.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported revenue of approximately RMB 476.8 million, a 62.35% increase year-over-year, and net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 45.5 million, up 198.73%. The company has shown strong growth driven by increased aerospace orders and new AI computing services. Total assets grew significantly to over RMB 2.17 billion with an increased leverage ratio. R&D investment reached over RMB 30 million, representing 6.32% of revenue. The company has a workforce of over 400 employees, including more than 100 R&D personnel.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes advanced precision manufacturing technologies and integrated aerospace component solutions, offering high-quality, reliable, and customized products that meet stringent military standards. Its unique value lies in proprietary core technologies, comprehensive product coverage across multiple aerospace systems, and the ability to rapidly respond to complex and customized military requirements. The integration of digital and intelligent manufacturing enhances product quality and delivery efficiency, while expanding into civilian sectors diversifies its market and reduces dependency on military contracts.
